fusions.name: Feint, Then Snap
fusions.desc: A feint draws the target's guard, then you bite for 12 damage, leave it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds and stun it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Stolen Kill
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Darts in to snatch it, which deals 24 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles.

fusions.name: False Trail
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and you move 15% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Easy Mark
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage.
